Subject: Evidence request: personnel screening & training artifacts for SOC 2 period Jan–Oct 2026

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As part of our SOC 2 readiness work for Redwood Inference, we need a consolidated personnel controls package covering hires and separations during Jan–Oct 2026. Please provide the following by COB Thu Nov 19 if possible: 

- Background check policy and a sample set of redacted background check results (5–10 samples) that show matching criteria used (identity verification, criminal, employment verification).
- A CSV summary (not PII) reflecting: employee id (hashed), hire date, role, screening vendor, screening outcome, remediation actions if any.
- Training completion records for Security Awareness and Data Handling (date completed, training version).
- Onboarding checklist template and a small set of completed onboarding artifacts for new hires.
- Offboarding/termination audit logs for 3 recent separations (timestamped revocations of access).
- Evidence of HR vendor SLAs and sample contract or SOC report for the background vendor, if available.

Small note on data handling: redact or hash any sensitive PII (SSN, DOB) — summary CSV is sufficient for the audit. We can accept hashed identifiers + separate mapping held by you if necessary. Secure upload via the link we provided in the portal or via an SFTP/ShareFile. If you prefer, we can accept a DocuSign attestation for any items you cannot share directly.

Please confirm ETA and whether you need a DocuSign envelope for attestation.

Thanks,
Erik Marin
Senior Auditor
BrightLine Audit

4) Vendor evidence: ClearHire can provide their vendor SLA and SOC letter; I have looped them in. If they cannot produce a SOC letter, we'll provide the contract excerpt plus their security questionnaire response.
